Container.Name: Cody
Container.Overview: Cody — a web workspace for the omp (oh-my-pi) coding agent. Session browsing, live chat, Git panel with staging and checkpoints, persistent terminals, workspace tasks, and an embedded app preview. This container bundles the omp harness; point /workspace at your projects share and open the WebUI.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Agent state, checkpoints and shell home. Keep on appdata.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Your repositories — the workspaces Cody and the agent operate on.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: HTTP Basic Auth password (username: cody). Required — the container refuses to start without it unless CODY_ALLOW_NO_AUTH=1.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Optional: API key for the agent's model provider. Any provider env var omp understands can be added the same way.
